about_the_game:
Nightmares are spilling into reality.
Become a guardian of dreams, combine powerful allies and mystical relics, and repel the horrors pouring from the Nightmare Gates.
A tactical defense game blending auto-chess synergy and tower defense strategy!

About the Game

『Luna & Sol: Nightmare Ward』 is a strategic defense game that fuses the depth of auto-chess with the intensity of tower defense.
As a guardian of dreams, you must confront terrifying creatures born from trauma-fueled nightmares.

Recruit allies with unique dream classes and professions, combine them to unleash powerful synergies, and build the ultimate defense.
Every run offers new combinations, powerful relics, and ever-growing challenges that test your wit and adaptability.

 Key Features

  • Strategic Synergy System
    Combine dream types and job classes to unlock devastating effects and team bonuses.

  • 10 Nightmare Gates
    Face nightmarish monsters and deadly bosses, each with distinct patterns and tactics.

  • Over 100 Relics
    Collect relics during battle to enhance your power. Mix and match to find unique playstyles.

  • Progress Beyond Death
    Even in defeat, your guardian grows stronger. Embrace the challenge and rise again.

Dreams don’t collapse easily—as long as you don’t give up.
Begin your fight to defend the gates of dreams today.
